25310.synopsis:
Twenty years earlier, the ‘Blade of the South’ Li Zhi was condemned a bandit by imperial decree for establishing the 48 Strongholds of the Shu Mountains to shelter the destitute refugees of the world. 
Twenty years later, a young man going by the name of Xie Yun, carrying an ‘Anping Command’, barges into the 48 Strongholds by night. Sir Gan Tang receives the command and descends the mountain, henceforth setting into motion the gears of fate.
Zhou Fei, a descendant of the ‘Blade of the South’, is born and raised within the 48 Strongholds, but has yet to experience the martial world. She begins to stray from this straight road after she encounters Xie Yun.
However, the current martial arts world is embroiled in turbulence, those once carefree and worry-less youths are swept without warning into the midst of turmoil and unrest; and ‘that’ secret which has been buried for 20 years, is about to be uncovered…

I reincarnated into a novel that I’d read in my past life.

Prince Jung, now called Aran, must find a new life and allies in order to survive. His unrivaled beauty is his curse and one of his greatest blessings.

The third young master of the Gu household, Gu Ye, had a wooden personality, a stuttering speech, couldn’t remember an answer after being told ten times, didn’t dare to protest after being bullied, was considered the shame of high society. The Gu Ye who used to remain silent after being beaten had laid out a stall, stepping on a few hoodlums beneath his foot, and was selling drawings while he called out: “Exorcism Wards! Guanyin safety talismans! Wards against evil for the house! Anti-goblin and demon talismans! …… Supersale on wards and talismans! If you have the right karma, 88 per ward! Don’t pass this by!”

30686.synopsis:
Lin Xun is a programmer. After coding all night, he found a program input window in his body.
He tried to program a cycle program.
The next day, the old man next door came to the door: Xiao Xun, you are so young but you have entered the Qi Refining period. Do you want to be my disciple?
On the third day, Lin Xun was patted on the street with a shoulder: Boy, your Spiritual roots are surprising, how about joining my sect?
Lin Xun: “? ? ?”
Later, he discovered that modern society really has immortals. While others rely on spiritual power to cultivate immortals, he relies on programming himself, and he can also see the programs in other immortals.
A Nascent Soul: “How can you peep through my flaws?”

34270.synopsis:
Ye Jiao woke up to find herself already riding in a wedding sedan chair—a wedding meant to bring a sick groom good fortune. It looked like she was doomed to a life of widowhood.
Qi Yun was frail and sickly, plagued by an ill-fated birth chart and constantly hovering near death’s door. No medicine seemed to help.
Yet after marrying Ye Jiao, his health began to miraculously improve.
Destined to die by thirty, he somehow ended up living toward a hundred years.
Only then did they realize the luckiest person under heaven was actually his own wife…

35294.synopsis:
Also known as [How do I bend the Villain Roommate] , a master-disciple relationship on the surface.
It’s one thing to transmigrate into a book, but what’s that about transmigrating into a rabbit spirit that has cultivated a human form?
Although Bai Yuming was the sect’s highly respected and prestigious Yuede Immortal Master, a celebrated rabbit spirit elder, but the only role he had in the book was that he was turned into a rabbit fur scarf by the protagonist.
The little rabbit wasn’t willing to part with his soft and white fur, packing his little bundle, he was ready to escape at any time.
However the opportunity never came, and the little rabbit came across the little villain with crippled spiritual roots.
Alas, seeing that they would both be slaughtered by the protagonist in the future, he would just let him stay to have a meal.
“Master, this is the carrot that I grew.”
Refreshing and crunchy, delicious!
“Master, I made a new den for you.”
Dry and comfortable, good to use!

But no matter how the little rabbit tried to live as a recluse, the little villain still entered the Demonic path and was chased out from the sect, enduring the whole cultivation world’s rejection.
He too walked along the original body’s destiny and was imprisoned.

43742.synopsis:
Raidorl Zain was born and raised as the second prince of the Kingdom of Zain.
Raidorl lived a peaciful life surrounded by his kind elder brother and loyal vassals, however his fate completely changed drastically during his coming-of-age ceremony when he was chosen to be the holder of “Dáinsleif “, the excalibur (sacred sword) of the royal house.
His brother the first prince started to hate him as an enemy that threatened his claim to the throne, his vassals and even his own fiancée abandoned him and he was banished to a town in develpment at the borders alone.
Since then, Raidorl has struggled to survive at the borders that were a monster’s domain, gaining the trust of those around him, he found a new happiness with his friends in that poor and harsh life.
However… his fate change once again when the neighboring Arsline Empire started to invade the Kingdom of Zain.
Forced by his brother to fight to protect the kingdom from the Empire’s invasion, Raidorl decides to plot a rebellion against the overly selfish demands of all those people that banished him.
When the exiled prince takes the sacred sword on his hand, the curtains of a new heroic legend will open!

46302.synopsis:
The protagonist, Kisaragi Manaka, had fallen in love for the first time in his life when he was in his second-year of middle school.
Clear skin, black hair and eyes, a lovely face, and a kind and cheerful personality.
He fell in love with such a girl, Kannazuki Sayaka.
They didn’t have any particular connections with each other, nor were they in the same class.
However, when she talked to Manaka in one of their joint lessons, he fell in love with her in an instant.
Yes, it was the so-called “love at first sight”.
From then on, Manaka worked very hard.
When he heard that Kannazuki thought people who could study well are cool, he studied like mad. When he heard that she thought athletic guys are cool, he went to a gym.
He did all of those for the sake of going out with her.
However, Manaka had suddenly heard devastating news. It was when he was in the third-year of middle school, that he heard Kannazuki was going out with a guy from another school.
At that moment, Manaka’s first love had ended.
Nonetheless, when Manaka became a first-year highschool student, he still couldn’t throw that first love away.
“I already know that she’s already dating someone, but I… still love her.”
He was certain that venturing out and finding a new love would be for the best.
However, he still couldn’t give up his feelings.
Then, a certain incident resulted in him having to rescue the class’ top beauty, Hiiragi Stella.
She had long blonde hair and a refined demeanor. A half-british girl who is always surrounded by people in the class, otherwise known as the popular “Saint.”
The incident resulted in Hiiragi approaching Manaka, however the latter, having not yet forgotten his first love, dismissed it as something trivial.

Belcansus, the land of the barbarians. Duke Atelien’s beautiful illegitimate child, Chesney, became a barbarian bride through an arranged marriage, for the sake of the state religion.

47582.synopsis:
Xu Mingyi is good everywhere, bright and dazzling, just like the scorching sun in the sky.

 Original Male Lead: “Aren’t you going to fight over the family fortune with me?”

49118.synopsis:

The eldest daughter, Chloe Verdier, with her injured leg, is also struggling to get her sister married and while doing so she finds herself vulnerable to the Duke Damien Ernst von Tisse, with whom she reunited at a ball on a summer night. The bad relationship with the duke, whom she had an unpleasant first meeting, during the war three years ago, was still ongoing.
Meanwhile, Alice has an irreversible accident, and in the end Chloe goes to the arrogant young duke to save her family  and tries the biggest gamble of her life….

50654.synopsis:

Cutting classes, fighting, poor grades, smoking and clubbing to make girlfriends, he did all kinds of bad things.

“Brother Yu, the grandsons of No. 3 High School are looking for trouble again! What should we do?”

[Your assigned role is Librarian.] 
[Time remaining until escape: 14 days (2 weeks).] 
Trapped in a school at midnight, with no memory of your name or where you came from.
The only thing you can rely on is a strange notebook left on the library counter.
[Trust the Code of Conduct. These are absolute rules you must follow.] 
[Your current chance of escaping is 8%. Record the school. Make sure the record does not disappear.] 
[Reveal your role to others. Do not reveal the records you write. Do not trust them. Do not doubt him.]

“Get a hold of yourself and hide behind me. If you stay like that, you’re going to die!”

You weren’t the only one trapped here.
Together with a mysterious man who claims he will protect people, will the Librarian manage to escape this school safely after two weeks?

174302.synopsis:
Gu Yuan transmigrated, becoming an ancient Titan whose body floated in the cosmic abyss, its size comparable to a galaxy. 
The bad news: he was on the verge of death, his body filled with void viruses capable of devouring planets, abyssal parasites that tore through dimensions, and countless rebellious cancerous kin. 
The good news: he had awakened the [Divine Body System] , allowing him to connect to Blue Star and disguise his internal world as a holographic online game called “Titan: Genesis”! 
Thus, a group of crazy fourth-disaster players descended. 
In Gu Yuan’s eyes: These were diligent white blood cells devouring pathogens, platelets repairing blood vessels, and antibodies precisely eliminating cancer cells. In the players’ eyes: “Holy shit! The graphics in this game are explosive!  Surfing in the Scarlet Star River (blood vessels) at the start!” 
“Brothers! That ten-thousand-meter demon dragon (roundworm) lurking in the Abyssal Rift Valley (intestines) is dropping divine artifacts! Let’s team up and hunt it!” 
“Extra! The hidden class [Thunder Envoy] (neuron) job transfer scroll only costs 100,000 bio-energy. Hurry if you want to Cultivate Immortality!” 
… Unknowingly, the players went crazy. They turned Gu Yuan’s lungs into the “Divine Realm of Wind,” his stomach into the “Sea of Alchemical Poison,” and his heart into the “Royal Court of Gods.” 
And when the players logged off, they were astonished to discover— Terminal illness had miraculously healed, nearsightedness had become clairvoyance, and they could even conjure fireballs with their bare hands! 
The world went crazy! 
The moment Gu Yuan fully recovered and stood up from the cosmic abyss, the gods and demons of all heavens trembled. “Who said I am alone? Within me, there are billions of gods!”

I transmigrated as Giselle Vellasi, the female lead of an R-19 dark romance novel.

182238.synopsis:
Ying Shi is a university student and also a film and television blogger.
One day, an online dispute escalated into a real-world confrontation, and she was stabbed by an obsessive fan of a celebrity.
When she woke up, she found herself miraculously alive and in good health!

Later, before the series aired—
“She really thinks that just because she’s criticized a few TV shows, she can make one herself? Just pulling a few unknown actors and daring to invest in a project—it’s definitely going to flop!”
“Another ‘Goddess saves the world’ trope—so tired. Wouldn’t a nice, simple sweet drama be better?”
“Giving up on professionally trained actors and picking idol trainees who failed to debut—she’s really lost it.”
“This lead actor is full of scandals—can we get him banned?!!!”
After the series aired—
“Wahhh, even though there’s no dramatic plot, why am I crying from sweetness?”
“A true goddess! A career-focused goddess who has no time for romance! I’m your believer!!”
“How could he, with a face that looks like the pinnacle of creation, look so ugly during the talent show? And with such acting talent, why was he even trying to sing and dance?”

197598.synopsis:
“Real Estate Tycoon” is a building simulation game that updates new components every week, satisfying players’ wildly imaginative construction ideas. Chi Yu is someone who dislikes interacting with others and is socially anxious. To focus on playing the game, he stockpiles several months’ worth of food and lives a happy, shut-in gaming life.
Three months later, he completes the community he modeled after a nearby neighborhood, and his food supplies also run out. Chi Yu goes downstairs to the supermarket to restock and discovers that the neighborhood is very quiet. The supermarket staff are all smiling brightly, looking a bit like NPCs he created in his game. There are also a few people covered in dust squatting in front of the shelves, shouting loudly.
Chi Yu doesn’t look closely, quickly pays, and leaves. Before entering his home, he breathes a sigh of relief. That was close. He almost had to greet someone.
Then he notices the game has updated, unlocking a house-selling feature. He cheers happily. Great. He can finally sell houses to the little people and earn coins.
———
Apocalyptic disaster strikes, and monsters run rampant.
Happy Community, like everywhere else, falls into ruins. Three months later, survivors return to the area to scavenge for supplies, only to be shocked to discover that Happy Community is still standing perfectly intact.
Not only that, but the community’s facilities are fully functional, the supermarket is well-stocked, and the store clerks greet customers with warm smiles, making it feel as if they’ve returned to the world before the apocalypse.
The survivors are unwilling to leave this place. At that moment, a property management staff member approaches them and asks with a smile, “May I ask if you would like to purchase a property here? The first ten buyers get an internal discount!”
———
First District Top-Secret File — “The Fantasist”
This is a special existence that is friendly toward humanity. No one has ever seen Its true form. After exhaustive research, all that is known is that It favors orderly architecture and bright, pleasant weather. Because the First District exists based on Its imagination, It is referred to as “The Fantasist.”
Remember: observe from a distance, remain silent, and do not break Its fantasy.
